capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: Ultium 85.0 kWh (usable capacity) NMC for the North American Optiq; KBB lists 85.00 kWh on all trims. 2025-2027 same pack (the 2026 update changed outputs and added RWD, not the pack, per Wikipedia reference titles).

dc_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: maximum 150 kW DC, claimed 79 miles in 10 minutes. The Charge Port publishes no figure. Same pack and charger as the Equinox EV (150 kW).

ac_max_kw.notes: Charge Port: 11.5 kW standard, 19.2 kW with the upgraded charger on some trims; powertrain value is the standard charger (as for the LYRIQ records).
